name: World Wonders (fan expansion for Catan)
description: The Island of Catan is rich with resources and beauty. The great nations meet upon the island for a decade-long festival of culture and trade... and a grand competition. Living solely off of the land, they must build the greatest society they can in a short time. To do this, the nations decide to recreate the Wonders of the Ancient World. But only one of each Wonder can exist, and there are only so many Wonders that the land can support!  This expansion, which has been in development for over...

name: In the Stocks (fan expansion for Carcassonne)
description: When a player draws a tile with stocks he must play it to an existing city. The player is free to deploy his follower  to the city or he may place a follower into the stocks.  A player is not obligated either to deploy a follower to the city or detain a follower in the stocks. If the tile cannot be played, it is removed from the game and a new tile drawn to replace it.  Approved by carcassonnecentral and carcassonne-forum

name: 7 Dice Wonders
description: A Print And Play dice game based on  7 Wonders  by Antoine Bauza from Repos Production. The artwork (for the icons) is based on the original artwork by Miguel Coimbra.  This game was created for the "In-A-Tin" / "Express" Print-and-Play Design Contest - Discussion Thread and shall forever be a free print and play game, by a fan for other fans of the original. name: Founders of Gloomhaven
description: Description from the publisher:  Founders of Gloomhaven is a competitive tile-placement, action-selection, city-building game in which each player controls a fantastical race working to build the city of Gloomhaven and gain influence over its residents. This is a standalone game set in the same universe as Gloomhaven. The events, however, take place hundreds of years before Gloomhaven and depict the original construction of the city. name: Azul
description: Introduced by the Moors, azulejos (originally white and blue ceramic tiles) were fully embraced by the Portuguese when their king Manuel I, on a visit to the Alhambra palace in Southern Spain, was mesmerized by the stunning beauty of the Moorish decorative tiles. The king, awestruck by the interior beauty of the Alhambra, immediately ordered that his own palace in Portugal be decorated with similar wall tiles. As a tile-laying artist, you have been challenged to embellish the walls of the Roy...

name: A Dream of Splendor in Song Dynasty
description: Background Amidst the vibrancy of the Song Dynasty, A Dream of Splendor places players in the shoes of ambitious entrepreneurs entrusted with the revival of a fading street in Bianjing. As the proprietor of a struggling restaurant, the challenge is twofold: astutely manage a 50-tael debt while revitalizing the once-thriving district. Your strategic decisions in resource management, shop construction, and menu refinement will either breathe life back into these forgotten alleys or consign them...

name: Frogmouth Fan Pack (fan expansion for Wingspan)
description: A mini expansion created by a fan focused on different species of frogmouth. The expansion includes 14 new birds and 1 new bonus card. As a curiosity all cards have a black background.

name: The Resistance
description: The Empire must fall. Our mission must succeed. By destroying their key bases, we will shatter Imperial strength and liberate our people. Yet spies have infiltrated our ranks, ready for sabotage. We must unmask them. In five nights we reshape destiny or die trying. We are the Resistance!  The Resistance is a party game of social deduction. It is designed for five to ten players, lasts about 30 minutes, and has no player elimination.
